applies_to: Air Monitor (ONICON group) ELECTRA-flo/SD thermal dispersion airflow probes and transmitters, set to BACnet MS/TP by DIP switch.
summary: The ELECTRA-flo/SD measures duct air velocity and temperature with thermistor sensors and sends them over BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU, DIP-selectable). It has four Analog Inputs (velocity, velocity pressure, temperature, volumetric flow) and one writable Analog Value for the duct area. Airflow reads 0 until the duct area is written.
default_device_instance: Same as the DIP-switch MAC address
notes: The manual gives the Analog Input object names only as 'Various'; their names here are the descriptions from the object table. AV 0 keeps its printed default name 'AV-0' (Duct Area Scale Factor).
Volumetric flow (AI 4) is velocity times the duct area written to AV 0: square feet in US units, square meters in SI units.
AI Present_Value and Out_Of_Service are listed as writable; inputs only accept writes for testing.
Source: ELECTRA-flo/SD with BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU output manual DOC-0005317 Rev. A, section 4.3.

source.title: ELECTRA-flo/SD with BACnet MS/TP or MODBUS RTU Output

integration.summary: Set S1 SW5 down for BACnet, the MAC address and baud on the DIP switches, then write the duct area to AV 0 once. Read volumetric flow, velocity and temperature.

minimum_points.name: AV-0
minimum_points.why: Duct area, ft2 (US) or m2 (SI); write once

setup: Protocol: S1 bank SW5 down = BACnet.
MAC address 0-127 on the S2 DIP switches; baud 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800 by DIP switch; 120 ohm termination by DIP switch.
Device instance starts equal to the MAC address and can then be written in the device object (0-4,194,303).
gotchas: AI 4 reads 0 until AV 0 holds the duct area.
AV 0 must match the unit system: square feet for US units, square meters for SI.

points.name: AV-0
points.description: Duct Area Scale Factor: duct area used to compute airflow
